text:
alex: heads up — charts are dog-slow on prod after the 11:42 canary. LCP for /dash up ~1.4s and main thread parse spikes. Anyone else seeing this?

maria: yup seeing big parse/compile time in RUM. Devtools shows main bundle parse ~650ms on a 2020 MBP.

jin: rolling back canary now? deploy-bot: deploy started by @jin for rollout/console-canary@f2b3c1 -> initiating rollback. :rotating_light:

sam: quick data point from telemetry (console-client):
```
metric: frontend_main_parse_ms
filter: route:/dash
p50: 120
p95: 680
p99: 1400
```
Looks like p95 jumped post-deploy.

lisa: I captured a flame for a cold load — big time in `parseScript` for a duplicated `viz-core` chunk. Webpack shows two chunks referencing the same module graph.

alex: duplication? that would explain parse/bytes. could be splitpoint change + lazy preload causing two chunk copies. Any proof in the source-map?

maria: yes: the sourcemap map reveals `viz-core/index.js` appears in `chunk-analytics` and `chunk-viz` after the split refactor. I can paste the shortest repro:
```
// in prod bundle list
chunk-analytics.js -> requires viz-core/index.js (internal id 412)
chunk-viz.js -> requires viz-core/index.js (internal id 412)
```
Both bundles include the module because the import changed from `./viz` to `./viz/index.browser` in one path. Case-insensitive resolver caused duplication.

jin: oh neat — so two distinct resolved paths. that'll create two module instances in the bundle. Fix should be to normalize import paths in the refactor and re-run splitpoints.

sam: aside: telemetry client also got a size bump in the same deploy (`telemetry-client@2.5.0`) — it inlines an uploader worker which adds ~90KB. Combined that with duplicate viz module and we have +300KB main payload.

lisa: quick mitigation options: 1) rollback (in flight), 2) hotfix to normalize imports and patch build, 3) patch split config to force `viz-core` into a shared chunk.

alex: rollback landed (thx jin). For next steps, I can open a tiny PR to normalize imports and add an eslint rule to prevent `index`-vs-`index.xyz` divergence. Will also add a build-time check to fail on duplicate module ids across chunks.

maria: please also add a telemetry tag to the rollout so we can correlate. I want a per-route breakdown in the console dashboard to show improvement after the fix.

jin: action items:
- alex: PR to normalize imports + eslint (ETA today EOD)
- sam: cut telemetry-client revert or shrink-worker patch (ETA tomorrow morning)
- lisa: attempt split config change on staging to put viz-core in shared chunk and run canary (ETA tomorrow)
- maria: add console dashboard filter + comparison panel for the canary window (ETA today)

deploy-bot: rollback succeeded for rollout/console-canary@f2b3c1 — status: success.

sam: small experiment idea: turn off `preload` for `chunk-analytics` on staging to see if duplicate prefetching worsens the parse time (might be prefetch thrash).

lisa: good call. Also opening an alert rule: `frontend_parse_p95 > 500ms for 5m` for /dash so we catch regressions faster.

alex: note for postmortem — root cause was import path divergence creating module duplication + telemetry client worker adding bump = combined regressions. We'll capture in postmortem once the fixes land.

maria: thanks everyone. I'll watch the telemetry once fixes are merged and will post an update in #eng-platform. :thumbsup:
